title: Resolvent Expansions at All Spectral Thresholds for Three-Dimensional Discrete Schrödinger Operators
summary: This paper studies resolvent expansions at all four spectral thresholds for the discrete Schrödinger operator $H=-Δ+V $ on $\Z^3$, where $Δ$ denotes the discrete Laplacian on $\mathbb{Z}^3$ and $V(n)$ is a real-valued decaying potential of $\mathbb{Z}^3$. At the thresholds 0, 4, 8, and 12, we first give a complete classification of the threshold types and derive the corresponding resolvent expansions in weighted $\ell^2$-spaces, including the non-generic cases of resonances and eigenvalues.
